description:
Baros is a private, focused workout tracker for iPhone. Log exercises, sets, weight, reps, RPE, rest time, and notes without creating an account.

Built for fast, distraction-free training:

• Start from a template, repeat a past workout, or begin from scratch
• Track every set with weight, reps, and optional RPE
• Rest between sets on a timer, with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen
• Group exercises into supersets that are checked and rested together
• See your heaviest rep and estimated 1RM for every lift
• Review your workout history, notes, and a year of training at a glance
• Create and manage your exercise library
• Export your workout history
• Keep your data local while signed out

Create an account only when you want account-backed sync across devices. Baros gives you the tools to record your training without social feeds, ads, or unnecessary clutter.
promotionalText: New in Baros 1.5: workout templates, supersets, and strength records that show your heaviest rep and estimated 1RM over time.
